mission.title: A Simple Request
mission.description: Wipe out the last Unlimit survivors, then accompany Agent Pace to her first meeting with Zion.

npc.say: Let Agent Pace handle the communication with Zion, operative. She has been programmed for this duty.
These meetings will be di reguardo, {player}--very important! I am glad that you will be there to help me.
There, you see, {player}? I knew that Zion would be reasonable.
We deplore Anome's rampage as much as you do. Like I said, Zion Command will be informed of the Agent's request.
Agent Pace is waiting for you in the next room, operative. We expect your report to be...constructive.

I am certain that Zion will cooperate with us in this matter, {player}. Ghost said that they very much regretted the trouble their ex-controller, Anome, caused to the System. Surely they will see that we can help them by analyzing the population data in their mainframe!

phase.briefing:
{player}, with the death of Anome, and the recapture of the remaining cheat codes, Unlimit's threat to the System has ended. We must now consider the initial source of this, and other recent threats: Zion.
Terrorist groups of all stripes continue to spawn from the chaos of their unmonitored population. As recent events have shown, this situation is becoming untenable. We have requested a meeting with Zion representatives to discuss the matter; we expect you to be available for this occasion.
Our studies of the cheat code mutations indicate that without further exposure to the codes, the remaining Unlimit soldiers will rapidly diminish in power, and that the side effects of their mutations will soon prove fatal. However, at the moment, a desperate group of Unlimit survivors is marauding across the city. You have been assigned to terminate them.

enter.say: You know, I feel for those people who swallowed Anome's story, but it sounds like we'll be doing them a favor by putting them out of their misery--not to mention saving some bluepill lives in the process.
I've got Unlimit code corruption in there. Maybe I should save a copy of this readout--might be the last time we see it.

done.say: Code corruption's clearing up; looks like you got 'em. Nice knowing you, Unlimit.

phase.briefing: You display admirable celerity in fulfilling your tasks, operative. Now that you have dealt with that...loose end, we have another function for you. Proceed to the indicated location and interface with Agent Pace. She has details pertaining to a preliminary meeting with Zion.

talk.say:
Ciao, tesoro! I have been chosen to engage in an initial meeting with a Zion representative, and I'm happy to have learned that you'll accompany me to assist in my contact with them. I still have much to learn of human interactions.
Because of all the problems we've been having with terrorist groups from Zion, we're going to ask them to help us prevent these problems by giving us access to some information from their mainframe. This seems like a very reasonable proposition to me. I am sure that Zion will be happy to assist us in protecting the System in this way, will they not?

done.say: Yuh, sounds perfectly reasonable to me, Agent Pace.

phase.briefing: Agent Pace will meet you at the location with Zion's representative, Ghost. We rely on you to monitor her activity for proper human communication protocols.

enter.say: Hurry up, {player}! Don't let that old crank Ghost hog all the Pace action!

talk.say: Ah, it is very simple, officer Ghost. We merely request facilitated access to necessary information in the Zion mainframe. This will help us detect and eliminate any problems, such as we have seen with Anome, and E Pluribus Neo, for instance, much more efficiently, before they threaten the safety of all humans inside the simulation. We will be very happy to offer you our unparalleled data processing capabilities for this service.

done.say: Looks like she did okay to me. Um, I mean...I think I need to study her code up close to make sure it's completely bug-free.

talk.say: I'll...pass that request along, Agent. I'm sure that Niobe will have a succinct answer for your organization.

phase.briefing: It appears that this initial meeting went according to plan, {player}. Agent Pace has asked you to provide her with your verbal analysis of her performance.

enter.say: I think this is the start of a beautiful relationship...

talk.say:
Grazie, {player}! I am very grateful to you for your feedback. I am glad that I performed adequately on this occasion, and I will continue to try to improve!
Officer Ghost seemed very reasonable. He is much more reserved than most of the Zionites I have met. I could not tell, but I hope that I made a favorable impression on him. If things go well, perhaps we will be working with him again!

done.say: You could probably hang out there for a while if you want. I'm just running a few scans...

mission.finish: Agent Pace has great potential in human relations, operative. However, I anticipate that I will be required to take an active role in the higher-level negotiations with Zion that will follow their reception of our request.
